trajectory_summary: Call opens as a third-party contact, quickly surfaces a mobile-home/manufactured-home hard gate, and the rep DQs on both roof-mount and ground-mount without escalating or verifying the brick underpinning detail the customer raises twice. Energy leaked from cooperative to resigned as the customer offered alternatives the rep didn't pursue.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown; this is clearly a dq call — home type (manufactured/mobile home with no viable mount option per rep) ended the pursuit. Worth flagging that the rep never checked whether 'ground mount' is genuinely outside Ion's capability or just outside this rep's knowledge — schema doesn't list ground-mount exclusion as a documented hard DQ.

observed_outcome.reasoning: Rep explicitly ends pursuit on the hard gate of home type (manufactured/mobile home, no roof-mount or ground-mount option), and confirms removal from the calling list — a clear DQ close, not merely no next step.
